Answer: C
Reason: The frontal view (Figure 1a) shows an opacity in the left mid-to-lower lung zone, and the lateral view (Figure 1b) confirms the lesion is located posteriorly overlying the lower thoracic spine, which is characteristic of a consolidation in the posterior segment of the left lower lobe. This peripheral/posterior distribution is also consistent with typical radiological findings in COVID-19 pneumonia.
